hero.title:
I turn complex systems
into clear interfaces.
hero.lede: Frontend developer with five years of building monitoring dashboards for power plants and steel mills, admin platforms, security portals and consumer apps.

journey.label: Journey
journey.title: From sales desk to source code
journey.lede: A marketing and sales background taught me how people actually use software. In 2021 I learned to code, and I haven't stopped shipping since.

items.title: Graduated, then marketing for a global firm
items.text: Freelance work for a global marketing company. Writing for real audiences, on deadline.

items.title: Sales management, close to the product
items.text: Joined a sales management team. Watching customers struggle with enterprise software is where it all started.

items.title: Learned to code. Shipped a Next.js migration.
items.text: Java was my first language. Months later I was rebuilding the Guardian-CCS homepage and portal in React and Next.js.

items.title: An admin portal from zero
items.text: Planned and built the Guardian admin portal with designers and backend developers, plus a Docusaurus docs site for overseas teams.

items.title: Enterprise scale, then industrial systems
items.text: Migrated SK Shieldus' ERP to React, then moved to industrial monitoring: sensor validation, FSRU operations and gas-pressure monitoring.

items.title: Steel, power, rewards and Vue
items.text: Monitoring systems for POSCO and Hyundai Steel, a TypeScript + GraphQL admin, a full-stack rewards app on AWS and a Vue 3 QA tool.

items.title: Making data-heavy UI easy to use
items.text: Renewing this portfolio and choosing what to build next.

work.label: Selected work
work.title: Work that runs real things
work.lede: Power plants, steel mills, passwordless security and rewards apps. Open any project to see the details and screens.
work.featText: Seven monitoring and optimization systems for POSCO, Hyundai Steel and energy operators. Emissions, sensor data and equipment efficiency on dashboards an operator can read at a glance.

stack.label: Stack
stack.title: A toolkit in orbit
stack.lede: Three rings around one core. Hover or tap a ring to see what's on it: the inner ring is my everyday frontend work, the outer one is what lets me ship end to end.
